articles.headline: Michigan State's Jordan Scott injures right shoulder in win over Northern Iowa
articles.description: Jordan Scott injured his right shoulder as No. 5 Michigan State beat Northern Iowa 106-72 on Friday night.

articles.headline: Jayhawks' Tyran Stokes sits due to bone bruise; status vs. Houston up in air
articles.description: Kansas freshman Tyran Stokes suffered a bone bruise in his knee during the Jayhawks' game a night earlier and is day-to-day.

articles.headline: Kansas' Melvin Council Jr. suffers broken foot, might be out until January
articles.description: Kansas guard Melvin Council Jr. suffered a broken foot in practice Monday and could be out until the start of Big 12 conference play which begins in January.

articles.headline: Gators' Boogie Fland aggravates shoulder injury, status vs. Houston in question
articles.description: Boogie Fland left the Gators' 86-78 win over Notre Dame after aggravating a right shoulder injury, and his availability for the Houston game is uncertain.

articles.headline: Gators PG Boogie Fland starts vs. Houston despite injury
articles.description: Florida guard Boogie Fland started against Houston on Wednesday despite being considered a game-time decision.

articles.headline: UConn's Solo Ball nearing surprise return amid rehab from wrist surgery
articles.description: UConn guard Solo Ball has been cleared for a return to full-contact practice after offseason wrist surgery, with the expectation that he'll return to game action this season.

articles.headline: UConn's Nik Khamenia to have foot surgery, be rechecked in 6-8 weeks
articles.description: UConn coach Dan Hurley said Thursday that starting forward Nik Khamenia will have surgery on his left foot and be reevaluated in six to eight weeks.

articles.headline: No. 4 UConn rolls past Wagner 83-41 but loses forward Nik Khamenia to injury
articles.description: — Silas Demary Jr. had 18 points and a career-high six steals to lead fourth-ranked UConn to a 83-41 win over Wagner on Monday night.

articles.headline: Nik Khamenia leaves No. 4 UConn's game vs. Wagner with injury
articles.description: UConn starting forward Nik Khamenia exited Monday's game against Wagner with a lower-body injury.
